  1. Launch the EMC (Simphony) application on your desktop.

     - Server: hyattpos.microsdc.com:443
     - User Name: Global ID number
     - Company: "HHC"
     - Password
  3. Click "OK".
  4. Click on the "Configuration" tab.
  5. Under "Personnel" section, click on "Employee Maintenance".
  6. Click on "Search".
  7. Ensure the screen is on the "Property Employee Records".
  8. Sort the list by "Class", then choose an existing name with the same Class level.
  9. Click on the existing user with the same class, then click on the "Employee Records".
  10. Click on the GREEN "+" at the top of the screen.
  11. Enter appropriate credentials, then click "OK":
      - Check Name: First name
      - Record Number: Global ID
